scope: Two official thematic road lists, 186 source rows. They are not a complete Shanghai municipal road register and do not establish building identities or geometry. No changes have been merged into the existing 1038 road-name snapshot.

matching_method.normalization: OpenCC t2s, strip a trailing parenthesized title qualifier, trim outer whitespace; match exact normalized name only
matching_method.composite_review_rule: A source name with parenthesis, 全线 or 国道上海段 is retained as a source group/system/segment and not automatically split.
matching_method.limits: Names alone do not establish physical-road identity. Names missing 路 (for example 华夏高架), same-name roads across districts, historical names and aliases need manual review. Existing-name matches do not copy editorial district assignments into official source rows.

limitations: 186 source rows may overlap each other and the existing road snapshot; match-status totals are not numbers of distinct roads.
The 2022 table provides no district column; districts are left empty for all 170 rows.
The 2023 table explicitly covers 15 districts with 16 segments; it does not include Huangpu or every street in covered districts.
Road names and extents are textual research leads, not reviewed building photos or dimensioned model specifications.
No administrative subdistrict-office names are treated as roads.
Document issue/publication dates are recorded; continuing legal effectiveness in 2026 has not been rechecked.

reuse.included: Factual road names, ranges, explicit districts, dates, source identifiers and links only; selected green-road segment length/plant facts
reuse.not_redistributed: Whole HTML pages, maps and photographs are not included. No map-data redistribution license is inferred.
